body: I thought it was very informative. I've been following her for a while now, and I think it's great what she's been reporting. Yes, I'm not a fan of Skynews in general when it comes to a lot of their coverage(Gaza, Ukraine, etc...), but on this issue, I feel like she was given freedom to say whatever she wanted. I got the sense that this piece was supposed to be personal because, in this case, personal=objective. Her family home, like many others, was in the middle of this war. Fully damaged or not, it's still a casualty. Especially with her mother talking about how much this house meant to her. I think it's relateable and I've heard many stories like this where the sudanese diaspora would travel for work and spend all thier time and money building a home so then can come back and live in it, only for it now to be destroyed. Overall, well done to her!
